_doc: Answer-key corrections (STEP 1, 2026-10-07). Additive only: each entry adds acceptable alternates (addAlt) and may relabel (newD). Original scripts/eval-department-routing.fixture.json is untouched; the eval reports BOTH keys. No label was clearly wrong, so there are no relabels.

changes.m: Hey, we got a bunch of new signups from the podcast, can you make sure they all get the welcome sequence?
changes.why: Welcome sequences are built and run in funnels as often as in the CRM (multi-department).

changes.m: Send a thank you card to everyone who referred a client this year
changes.why: A one-off personal/office errand; General Task is defined to take one-off personal work.

changes.m: Schedule a call with Dr. Lee next week
changes.why: Personal one-off scheduling is both Personal Assistant and General Task by their own definitions.

changes.m: Remind me to call my mom on Sunday
changes.why: Purely personal reminder; General Task covers personal one-offs.

changes.m: Order a birthday gift for my assistant
changes.why: Personal one-off errand; General Task covers it.

changes.m: Coordinate the launch across marketing, sales and support
changes.why: Cross-department work with no single owner is exactly General Task's definition (multi-department).

changes.m: Plan out the whole rollout for our new membership program, start to finish
changes.why: Cross-department rollout; General Task's definition names cross-department work (multi-department).

changes.m: The same payment reminder keeps failing every week, find the root cause and fix it so it stops
changes.why: A recurring failing automated job is also an AI-system maintenance task.

changes.m: Research our top five competitors and their pricing
changes.why: Competitive analysis is a research task and a marketing task.
A sales page lives in funnels; proofreading is also QC (multi-department).
A brochure is a design asset; existing alternates already allow marketing and communications.
